mandatoryCriteria: Strict resource hierarchy: Validates workspace -> project -> resource ancestry for all child entities (boards, columns, cards, comments, attachments)
Cross-project ID probing prevention: Guessing or providing an ID belonging to a sibling project returns uniform 404 NOT_FOUND with zero metadata leakage
Uniform error response: Sibling ID mismatch returns identical 404 response to non-existent ID, preventing enumeration attacks
Multi-parent validation: Child entity mutations verify both project and parent container match canonical database ancestry
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: requireProjectAncestry and verifyProjectAncestry adapters, middleware, and route guards across child entities on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: PostgreSQL RLS policies are documented as optional defense-in-depth.
